definitions.explanation: A container made of woven material such as bamboo or wicker.
An enclosure for keeping birds or small animals.

examples.japanese: {籠|かご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To put fruit in a basket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧{籠|かご}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{小鳥|ことり}→小鳥：01590_kotori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: The small bird escaped from the cage.

⟦ハムスター→ハムスター：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{籠|かご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。

notes:
{籠|かご} refers to both baskets and cages, depending on context.

TYPES:
- ⟦{鳥|とり}{籠|かご}→鳥籠：19574_torikago⟧ (birdcage)
- ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧{籠|かご} (shopping basket)
- ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧{籠|かご} (bamboo basket)
- ⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧{籠|かご} (laundry basket)

WRITING:
- Often written in hiragana (かご)
- {篭|かご} is an alternative kanji

COUNTER:
- Baskets: ⟦{個|こ}→個：00645_ko⟧ or {籠|かご}
- Cages: ⟦{個|こ}→個：00645_ko⟧

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ザル→ザル：04470_zaru⟧ (colander, strainer basket)
- ⟦バスケット→バスケット：27718_basuketto⟧ (basket - loanword)
